task: GAP-01 slice 2 — is the etamacro NumericalFailure pre-existing?
question: BENCH-01 recorded data/netlib/etamacro.mps as NumericalFailure, a model outside the LP-01 deferred set (bore3d, scsd1, scsd6, blend). docs/project/STATUS.md left open whether that failure pre-dates LP-01. This record answers it by running the same model through the same CLI on both sides of LP-01.

pre_lp01.relation: parent of LP-01 (e9327b0); RES-01 state, no sparse-path change

revisions.build: cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DMARKOV_CERO_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS=ON, same flags for both, in separate build trees

method.default_options: presolve on, Ruiz scaling on, PDLP tolerance 1e-4 — CLI defaults, no overrides

head.message: canonical witness rejected: scaled optimality verification failed: cok_fail ook_fail

pre_lp01.message: canonical witness rejected: scaled optimality verification failed: cok_fail ook_fail

head.message: canonical witness rejected: scaled optimality verification failed: cok_fail ook_fail

pre_lp01.message: canonical witness rejected: scaled optimality verification failed: cok_fail ook_fail

conclusion.basis: All four engines return byte-identical status, objective, iteration count and message on both revisions; no LP-01 (or later) change is implicated.
conclusion.interpretation: primal and ipm both reach the same objective, but the accepted-witness check in src/verify/sparse_lp_verifier.cpp refuses to certify it: the canonical complementarity residual is 2.15e-3 against a tolerance three orders of magnitude tighter, on a model whose estimated condition number is 8.3e17. The NumericalFailure is the honest outcome — the solver does not report Optimal for a witness it cannot verify.
conclusion.classification: pre-existing numerical failure, tracked alongside the LP-01 deferred set, not a regression and not fixed here

not_run: dense/sparse differential for etamacro — it is not one of the 17 fixtures in data/compare/netlib.txt, which is marked do-not-edit after results exist, so entry agreement for this model was not measured
no fix attempted: changing factorization, scaling or tolerance policy to certify this model is a numerical-contract change, not a documentation gap
no reference optimum for etamacro is recorded in evidence/bench01-preregistration-2026-10-01.json, so no objective agreement was checked
one host, one toolchain, no second solver
context_note: The LP-01 deferred set reproduces differently by path: bore3d and scsd1 fail through the CLI at both revisions (as above), while blend fails only through the library differential harness (lp_sparse_differential_test, no presolve/scale) and solves Optimal through the CLI at both revisions. Each observation in docs/contracts/sparse-lp-path.md §5 should be read with its own path in mind; this record states the CLI path explicitly for etamacro.
